mainEntity.name: What is the process for implementing Website Entity Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: The implementation process typically begins with an in-depth audit of your existing content and target entities. We then identify key entities relevant to your business and define their relationships. This is followed by content restructuring, schema markup implementation (structured data), and refinement of your internal linking strategy. Ongoing monitoring and adjustments ensure continuous improvement and adaptation to search engine updates.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an audit, identifying key entities, structuring content, implementing schema markup, and refining internal linking for continuous improvement.
